description: Frontend (UI/design, Issue 3): make the message list read like a real threaded conversation (like Kiro): role-labeled bubbles with user-vs-assistant alignment/styling, a clearly distinguished streaming assistant bubble, in a scrollable thread. This is a PRESENTATIONAL improvement over the EXISTING conversations store data (Message[] already carries role/status/content) - do NOT redesign the data model, the store, or the CoreEvent flow. MessageList currently renders a flat, unstyled list of MessageBubbles (there is no .message-list/.message-bubble CSS at all yet). Improve MessageList/MessageBubble presentation and add the CSS using the app's var(--ah-*) design tokens and the harbor-blue theme. Keep it clear-win scope; note anything deferred.
steps: MessageList.tsx: keep the store-driven data flow (activeConversationId, messages, openConversation) and the empty-state guards unchanged. Wrap the mapped MessageBubbles so the container is a vertical scrollable thread (role="log" already present). Add auto-scroll-to-bottom on new messages/deltas via a ref + useEffect keyed on items.length and the last message's content length (guard for jsdom: only call scrollIntoView/scrollTo when it exists). Do NOT change what data is rendered.

MessageBubble.tsx: keep rendering every MessageContent variant and the RouteBadge/StreamingIndicator. Improve the presentation: keep the existing data-role/data-status attributes (tests and CSS key off them) and the role label header; the alignment/coloring is driven by CSS on [data-role]. Keep the error rendering from FEAT-002 (actual reason text). Do not remove existing testable text/roles.

app.css: add a threaded-conversation stylesheet block using ONLY var(--ah-*) tokens. Requirements: .message-list is a column flex, scrollable (overflow-y:auto), gap between bubbles; .message-bubble is a rounded card (var(--ah-radius-*)) with padding (var(--ah-space-*)); [data-role="user"] aligns right / uses --ah-accent-soft or --ah-accent with --ah-accent-contrast; [data-role="assistant"] aligns left / uses --ah-surface-2 with --ah-text; constrain bubble max-width (e.g. ~80%) so turns read as a thread; .message-bubble__role is a small muted label (var(--ah-text-faint)); a streaming assistant bubble is visually distinct (e.g. subtle border/opacity). Keep it consistent with the existing .composer/.streaming-indicator styling and both light and dark palettes (tokens already flip per theme).
Do NOT touch the embedded-engine feature-flagging or the embedded folder-scan rework. Keep the change presentational.

Tests (chat.test.tsx): assert the threaded structure in a way that is robust in jsdom - e.g. a user message bubble carries data-role="user" and an assistant bubble data-role="assistant" and both render within the role="log" message list; the existing MessageBubble variant test and streaming test continue to pass. Do NOT assert on pixel layout. If auto-scroll uses scrollIntoView, mock/guard it so tests do not throw.
acceptance_criteria: The message list renders as a scrollable thread with visually distinct user (aligned one side) and assistant (aligned other side) role-styled bubbles using var(--ah-*) tokens in both light and dark themes.
The streaming assistant bubble is visually distinguished and the StreamingIndicator still toggles with status.
No change to the conversations store data model, the CoreEvent flow, or what data each bubble renders.
Existing chat tests still pass; a test asserts data-role user/assistant bubbles render within the role=log list.
tsc strict, eslint, and prettier --check are clean; any scrollIntoView usage is jsdom-guarded.
verification: Run `(cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run build)` and confirm no type errors (CI/where network available).
Run `(cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm test)` and confirm chat tests (including the new threaded-structure assertion) pass.
Run `(cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run lint)` and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` and confirm clean.
findings: Implemented as a purely presentational change; no store/CoreEvent/data-model edits. Changes: (1) MessageList.tsx - added a useRef<HTMLDivElement> scroll anchor (div.message-list__end, aria-hidden) rendered after the mapped bubbles, plus a useEffect keyed on itemCount (items.length) and tailLength (a small lastTextLength() helper returning the last message's text length) that calls endRef.current?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "end" }). The optional-call chain is the jsdom guard: jsdom does not implement scrollIntoView, so `?.scrollIntoView?.` short-circuits and never throws under vitest. Data flow (activeConversationId/messages/openConversation), both empty-state guards, and what each bubble renders are UNCHANGED. Both hooks run unconditionally before the early returns (rules-of-hooks safe). (2) MessageBubble.tsx - left UNCHANGED; it already emits data-role/data-status, the role-label header, RouteBadge, StreamingIndicator, and the FEAT-002 error-reason alert. All presentation is CSS-driven off [data-role]/[data-status], so no TS edit was needed. (3) app.css - added a 'Message thread' + 'Streaming indicator' block using ONLY var(--ah-*) tokens (so light/dark harbor-blue both flip automatically): .message-list is a scrollable flex column (flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; gap var(--ah-space-3)); .message-bubble is a rounded (var(--ah-radius-lg)) padded card capped at max-width 80%; [data-role="user"] aligns flex-end on --ah-accent/--ah-accent-contrast; [data-role="assistant"] aligns flex-start on --ah-surface-2/--ah-text; system/tool center on --ah-accent-soft; [data-status="streaming"] is visually distinct (dashed accent border + opacity .85); .message-bubble__role is a small uppercase --ah-text-faint label (lifted to --ah-accent-contrast on the accent-filled user bubble for legibility); tool-call/tool-result/attachment and .message-bubble__error styling added to match; also added .streaming-indicator dot styling (pulse keyframes) since it had no CSS. Voice matches the existing .composer block. (4) chat.test.tsx - added 'MessageList renders a threaded view with role-styled user and assistant bubbles': renders MessageList with a user + assistant message (via get_messages mock), finds the role="log" list, and asserts it contains a [data-role="user"] and a [data-role="assistant"] bubble plus both texts; no pixel-layout assertions. Existing MessageBubble-variant, streaming/messageError, and error-reason tests are untouched and unaffected. VERIFICATION: build/lint/test are CI/user-build verification only - the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox has no network and node_modules is not installed (npm ci fails: 403/no registry), so tsc/eslint/vitest/prettier cannot run here. Validated by careful static review: tsc-strict types (Role includes 'user', MessageContent text variant matches lastTextLength cast), react-hooks/exhaustive-deps (effect deps are [itemCount, tailLength]; endRef is a stable ref), no unused vars, 2-space/double-quote/trailing-comma/printWidth-100 style matching neighboring files, and no em dashes. Nothing deferred; the clear-win threaded, role-styled, auto-scrolling view is complete. NOTE: internal .message-list scrolling is present but the outer .app__main already scrolls; I intentionally did NOT restructure the shell (.app__chat) height to avoid regressing other destinations - the auto-scroll anchor works regardless.
